title: Compiled machine preconditions
statement: Let $P$ be a counter program, let $l_0$ be its initial state, and let $lm$ be a Boolean parameter. If a bit string $y$ is a pairing of a unary string with a canonical binary word, then for every configuration of the compiled machine, its current instruction satisfies the required preconditions: any register-comparison instruction compares distinct registers, any input-word comparison is applied to an input of the required valid form, and any oracle call lists its argument registers without repetition.
